notes: Two isnads for the same saying (the finger gesture). The second («وحدثنا قتيبة بن سعيد») is a route because it carries the same saying (rule 4).
The first branch's saying is blank in the text (it ends at «قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم»); the second supplies the words through «سمعت النبي».
«- واللفظ له -» is a gloss: left out.
